fault: abort both sides of owned loopback byte relay; no TLS termination, no payload capture; keep listener and fsd alive
recovery: different worker PID plus online after authenticated initial resume; relay accepted count must increase
timing: first drop request to verified recovery, includes local control/D-Bus overhead
cache: read already opened immutable complete-cache handle during reconnect; compare hash to pre-fault bytes
interference: original six mounts, two probes and other idle readonly clone stay running; no mixed synthetic load
stop_rule: stop on first failed recovery; unrun trials remain unrun, retain failed sample
